Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body: Have they worked out a multiplayer version, or is it still only for 2?

Messages.Author: vtesocrates
Messages.Body:
> Non-existant user wrote:
> Have they worked out a multiplayer version, or is it still only for 2?
>
The press release says it's for two, but coming up with a way to make it for more players probably wouldn't be that hard. You could give the corp extra bits to fend off multiple runners or you could play even numbers with an equal amount of runners and corps. Considering Fantasy Flight has released rules for 2 player BSG (not really that much fun), I wouldn't be surprised if they tossed in a suggestion for larger games or released alternate rules as a PDF or something.
